name: Are there specific building codes for garage drywall in Bay Area cities like Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific building codes for garage drywall in Bay Area cities like Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Bay Area cities, including Daly City, follow California Building Code requirements, which often have specific stipulations for garage drywall. A common requirement is the use of 5/8-inch Type X fire-rated drywall on walls and ceilings that separate the garage from the living space and the attic. This code aims to provide a minimum fire-resistance rating. Furthermore, garages may have requirements for ventilation and proper fire blocking. It's crucial to consult the specific building department in your city or have a licensed contractor familiar with local codes ensure your project is compliant.
